title: Ilocos Norte dengue cases top 2,500 with 3 deaths

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—The nearby province of Ilocos Norte has recorded 2,501 dengue cases and three deaths from January to early October 2026, according to the Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (PESU) on Friday, Oct. 16. The province logged 107 new cases during Morbidity Week 40 (Oct. 4 to 10), covering the latest reporting period in the PESU data. Despite efforts to contain the mosquito-borne disease, health authorities continue to urge residents to take preventive measures to stop the spread of dengue, which is transmitted through the bite of an infected Aedes mosquito.
